dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: We sure burned through a lot of ammo back there... Ha, my gun's still hot to the touch.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I'll stay here to take care of my gun. Why don't you join me and rest up too?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Guns need rest... Just like people, right?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: There's no disputes to settle here — only enemies to defeat.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: So I can go all in? No holds barred, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Simple and straight to the point... Heh, suits me.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: What are all these shiny things on the ground? Can we... take some with us?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: They look like they'd make great bedside ornaments. I'm sure "Mom" would like 'em too.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: ...Though with that many spikes, it might be better to leave them out of the lair. Sounds like a recipe for an awful night's sleep...
